function.name: cell_divide
function.description: Simulate the division of a cell into two daughter cells. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

cell_id.description: The unique ID of the parent cell.

method.description: The method of cell division, i.e., 'mitosis' or 'meiosis'.

times.description: The number of times the cell will divide. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

message.content:
以下是幾家在倫敦備受推崇、口碑極佳的餐廳，涵蓋從高檔料理到隨性小吃，供您參考：

| 餐廳 | 位置 | 特色 | 推薦菜品 |
|------|------|------|----------|
| **Restaurant Gordon Ramsay** | Chelsea | 米其林三星，法式料理 | Lobster & Lobster Bisque, Beef Wellington |
| **Core by Clare Smyth** | Notting Hill | 米其林三星，英式創新料理 | Roast Chicken, Lamb Shank |
| **Sketch (The Lecture Room & Library)** | Mayfair | 米其林星級，藝術氛圍 | Beef Tartare, Lobster Ravioli |
| **Dishoom** | Shoreditch / Covent Garden | 印度風味，復古裝潢 | Bacon Naan, House Chai |
| **Padella** | Borough Market | 手工意大利麵，價格親民 | Tagliatelle Bolognese, Pappardelle Pomodoro |
| **Hoppers** | Soho | 斯里蘭卡料理，薄餅與咖哩 | Hoppers, Sri Lankan Curry |
| **The Palomar** | Soho | 以色列/地中海風味 | Char-grilled Octopus, Lamb Kebabs |
| **Borough Market** | Borough Market | 市場式餐飲，眾多攤位 | Fish & Chips, Vegan Burgers |
| **Gordon Ramsay Street Kitchen** | Soho | 休閒英式料理 | Fish & Chips, Shepherd’s Pie |

> **小提示**  
> - 若您想體驗米其林星級料理，建議提前預訂（至少提前一個月）。  
> - 如果偏好更隨性的用餐環境，Dishoom、Padella 或 Borough Market 都是不錯的選擇。  

如果您有特定的口味、預算或想要探索某個區域，隨時告訴我，我可以再為您精準推薦！
